component_instructions.description: A single robust React Native shared component replacing the buyer and owner views, removing the distinct minimal owner modal screen.
structure_requirements: 1. Root container should be flex: 1 with Colors.background.
2. Main content must be inside a ScrollView with paddingBottom to prevent overlap with the fixed bottom bar.
3. The bottom bar must be wrapped outside the ScrollView inside the main flex container, or absolutely positioned at the bottom.

HeroGallery.description: Full-width horizontal ScrollView with pagingEnabled. Map over item.image_urls or fallback to [item.image_url]. Height ~300. Use TagImage component.

TitleRow.description: Row with item.title. If isOwner is true, display a prominent Status badge (e.g., pending_review, approved, draft, rejected). If rejected, show admin comment box below.

PricingChips.description: Horizontal ScrollView displaying active pricing modes (price_per_hour, price_per_day, price_per_week, price_per_month, price_per_session). Prominent text formatting.

QuickInfoChips.description: FlexWrap row container displaying pill chips for category_label (fallback to raw category), condition_label, skill_level, brand_model.

Distances.description: Render only if !isOwner. Show location text with Ionicons location-outline.

Description.description: Collapsible text field using default numberOfLines={3} and a 'Lire plus' touchable to expand text.

InfosPratiques.description: A dark card block containing rows for pickup_type (car-outline), deposit_amount (shield-checkmark-outline), max_duration_days (time-outline), availability_note.

ContenuInclus.description: Display list of item.included_items if it exists. Use bullet points or small checkmark rows.

Conditions.description: CRITICAL: Inline display only. Only if !isOwner. Display item.return_rules and item.cancellation_rules inside the scroll content layout. DO NOT USE a 'Voir les conditions' button.

SellerProfile.description: Only if !isOwner. Card block showing seller_picture_url, seller_name, stars/rating, and 'Voir le profil'.

isOwner_true.layout: Row or stacked layout containing two buttons. 'Modifier l\'annonce' (primary blue) and 'Supprimer' (ghost red / destructive style).

isOwner_false.layout: Single prominent full-width 'Louer / Réserver' primary button.
